# A cloud. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Cloud --base-color 0.796 0.859 0.988 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --name Q0 --location -0.90 0 0.00
scale 1.30 0.5 0.85
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Cloud
active Q0
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.3"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --name Q1 --location 0.00 0 0.30
scale 1.82 0.5 1.19
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Cloud
active Q1
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.3"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --name Q2 --location 0.90 0 0.05
scale 1.43 0.5 0.94
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Cloud
active Q2
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.3"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --name Q3 --location 0.30 0 -0.10
scale 1.30 0.5 0.85
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Cloud
active Q3
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.3"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Q0 Q1 Q2 Q3
active Q0
join
rename Q0 Cloud
select all
shade flat
export cloud.glb
